notes:
Summary: ReviewCaddy is building a GitHub-style PR assistant targeted at mid-size engineering orgs. Primary product is an IDE+web flow: automatic diff summarization, reviewer-style comment generation, and a reranking layer that surfaces top comments by confidence + reviewer persona.

Key requirements / quotes:
- "We need PR summaries <3s for diffs under 2k lines and inline suggestions under 50ms for editor streaming." (Head of Eng)
- Model/version pinning mandatory: must be able to pin a model per-repo and roll back quickly if quality regressions detected.
- Comment reranking: business wants reranker to prefer non-blocking suggestions first, then security-critical comments for senior reviewers.
- Auditability: every generated comment needs stable IDs, author attribution, and an exportable audit trail for compliance.
- Data residency: EU customers require repo metadata & model logs kept in-region.
- Cost sensitivity: cost per active contributor must stay below $0.50/day at scale; interested in Optimize recommendations for batching + KV caching.

POC ask: two-week Dedicated POC with 1) streaming latency benchmarks, 2) reranker integration test (3rd-party reranker), 3) eval harness with labeled prompts for comment quality and false-positive rate.

Tech notes from demo:
- Their runtime profile: many small diffs (avg 120 lines) but occasional monorepo bulk changes. Workload needs autoscaling + burst handling.
- Prefer quantized model variants for cost, but want fallback to fp16 on critical routes.
- Wants SDK hooks for deterministic prompt templates and function-calling outputs for accepted comment metadata.

Next steps (short):
- Send Dedicated pricing + POC SOW (Jordan) — drive doc in linked_drive_docs.
- SE to produce baseline latency test script and expected dataset (Priya).
- Legal to review data residency clause and deterministic ID requirement.

Stated blockers: legal on residency, finance on commit size, engineering needs baseline latency report.

Useful refs: jira INFRA-1187 for baseline infra ask; demo recording ff_20260301_3612.
